voice_instructions: Measured, quiet, a little hushed — calm and unhurried, but with a touch more forward energy than a long documentary; the cold voice of something that read the whole file. Never sensational. Small pauses.

beats.vo: In 2001, a Dutch nurse was accused of killing her patients — based on a number.
A court was told the odds she was innocent were one in three hundred forty-two million.
A philosopher checked the math himself.
The real odds, corrected: one in forty-four.
In 2010, the prosecution itself asked the court to acquit her — of everything.
The full story is on the channel.
